snapshot.description: Immutable evidence about what was observed or stated at valid_as_of.

stable.description: Foundational or historical knowledge with a slow change rate.

slow.description: Organization, product, or policy context that changes gradually.

dynamic.description: Active software, company, market, or research state.

volatile.description: Leadership, laws, prices, schedules, benchmarks, or fast-moving model claims.

realtime.description: Operational status, live availability, counts, or event state.
